structured_output.summary: The change follows the spec for Uint8Array.prototype.toBase64. It validates `this` as a Uint8Array and gets the options object. It reads `alphabet`, checks it, then reads `omitPadding`. Only after those reads does it validate bounds and read the bytes. That order matters because the option getters can detach or resize the buffer. The base64 and base64url encoding handles every remainder case, including the empty array. Padding is omitted correctly. The gate report shows 12 new passes in the target (20 of 20), with no regressions and no not-implemented errors. I found no special-casing and no swallowed errors. The only blemish is that the step 9 and 10 comments are shortened with "...", which is cosmetic.
